info.long_name: Patients with a Lyme Disease Diagnosis, Excluding Travel History
info.short_description: Monthly count of patients with a Lyme disease diagnosis, excluding patients with a travel history.
info.long_description: Monthly count of patients with a Lyme disease diagnosis, per Epic's "n lyme" measure, restricted to patients without a travel history. Data from Epic Cosmos, which contains de-identified data from 300M+ patients across 1,600+ hospitals. Counts of 10 or fewer are suppressed by Epic (reported blank or as "10 or fewer") and imputed as 5; see epic_lyme_suppressed_flag. Population base per SlicerDicer session 2853292: data model Patients, population base All Patients, criteria Country of Care = United States of America, Not Travel History (New User Grouper 1), Not Diagnosis (All): Travel abroad, Has Any Encounters - the denominator (epic_n_patients) is all patients meeting those criteria, not restricted to any diagnosis or encounter type. Intended as a sensitivity comparison against epic_n_lyme in cosmos_vector_borne (which has no travel-history exclusion); the two are not perfectly comparable because this session also adds a "Has Any Encounters" restriction on the denominator that cosmos_vector_borne does not have - compare the epic_n_* counts across the two sources rather than the percentages.
info.statement: In {location}, {value} patients without a travel history had a Lyme disease diagnosis.

info.long_name: Percent of Patients with a Lyme Disease Diagnosis, Excluding Travel History
info.short_description: Monthly percent of patients (excluding travel history) with a Lyme disease diagnosis.
info.long_description: Monthly percentage of patients without a travel history who have a Lyme disease diagnosis, computed as epic_n_lyme / epic_n_patients * 100 - a percent of patients meeting this session's population base, NOT a rate per 100,000. Where the numerator was suppressed it is imputed as 5 before the percentage is computed. Where the denominator was itself suppressed the percentage is left missing; those cells are marked by epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag. Data from Epic Cosmos SlicerDicer session 2853292. Not directly comparable to epic_pct_lyme in cosmos_vector_borne because the denominator criteria differ.
info.statement: In {location}, {value}% of patients without a travel history had a Lyme disease diagnosis.

info.short_name: Suppressed flag: Lyme disease (no travel history)
info.long_name: Suppression flag for the Lyme disease numerator (count and percent), no travel history
info.short_description: Indicates whether the Lyme disease numerator was suppressed and imputed; applies to both epic_n_lyme and epic_pct_lyme.
info.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos suppressed the Lyme disease cell (a count of 10 or fewer, reported blank or as "10 or fewer") and epic_n_lyme was imputed as 5; 0 otherwise. The flag is computed before imputation, so it records what the source withheld rather than what the ingest wrote. It covers epic_pct_lyme as well, because the percentage is derived from this same numerator cell. Suppression of the denominator is tracked separately by epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag.

Where the denominator was itself suppressed the percentage is left missing; those cells are marked by epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag. Data from Epic Cosmos SlicerDicer session 2853292. Not directly comparable to epic_pct_west_nile in cosmos_vector_borne because the denominator criteria differ.
epic_pct_west_nile.statement: In {location}, {value}% of patients without a travel history had a West Nile virus diagnosis.

epic_west_nile_suppressed_flag.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos suppressed the West Nile virus cell (a count of 10 or fewer, reported blank or as "10 or fewer") and epic_n_west_nile was imputed as 5; 0 otherwise. The flag is computed before imputation. It covers epic_pct_west_nile as well, since the percentage is derived from the same numerator cell. Suppression of the denominator is tracked separately by epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag.

epic_n_dengue.long_name: Patients with a Dengue Diagnosis, Excluding Travel History
epic_n_dengue.short_description: Monthly count of patients with a dengue diagnosis, excluding patients with a travel history.
epic_n_dengue.long_description: Monthly count of patients with a dengue diagnosis, per Epic's "n dengue" measure, restricted to patients without a travel history. Data from Epic Cosmos, which contains de-identified data from 300M+ patients across 1,600+ hospitals. Counts of 10 or fewer are suppressed by Epic (reported blank or as "10 or fewer") and imputed as 5; see epic_dengue_suppressed_flag. Population base per SlicerDicer session 2853292: data model Patients, population base All Patients, criteria Country of Care = United States of America, Not Travel History (New User Grouper 1), Not Diagnosis (All): Travel abroad, Has Any Encounters. Most dengue cases in the continental US are travel-associated rather than locally acquired; comparing this count against cosmos_vector_borne's epic_n_dengue (which does not exclude travel history) gives a sense of how much of the signal there is travel-related.
epic_n_dengue.statement: In {location}, {value} patients without a travel history had a dengue diagnosis.

epic_n_patients.long_name: Total Patients Without a Travel History, With Any Encounter (Denominator)
epic_n_patients.short_description: Monthly total patient count (excluding travel history, with any encounter), used as the denominator for each disease's percentage.
epic_n_patients.long_description: Monthly total count of patients without a travel history and with any encounter, used as the denominator for epic_pct_lyme, epic_pct_babesiosis, epic_pct_malaria, epic_pct_rmsf, epic_pct_west_nile, and epic_pct_dengue in this source. Data from Epic Cosmos SlicerDicer session 2853292. Counts of 10 or fewer are suppressed by Epic and imputed as 5; see epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag. Population base: All Patients, criteria Country of Care = United States of America, Not Travel History (New User Grouper 1), Not Diagnosis (All): Travel abroad, Has Any Encounters. This denominator differs from cosmos_vector_borne's epic_n_patients (which has no travel-history exclusion or Has Any Encounters restriction), so percentages between the two sources are not directly comparable - compare the counts (epic_n_*) instead, or use this source's own percentages internally.

epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag.short_description: Indicates whether the total patient count was suppressed and imputed.
epic_n_patients_suppressed_flag.long_description: 1 when Epic Cosmos suppressed the denominator cell (a count of 10 or fewer, reported blank or as "10 or fewer") and epic_n_patients was imputed as 5; 0 otherwise. Where this flag is 1, every epic_pct_* column is left missing rather than computed from an imputed denominator.

epic_cosmos.name: Epic Cosmos
epic_cosmos.description: Epic Cosmos is a collaborative research platform containing de-identified patient data from over 300 million patients across more than 1,600 hospitals and health systems using Epic electronic health record systems. Data is accessed via SlicerDicer, a self-service analytics tool. The dataset includes emergency department visits, diagnoses, immunizations, laboratory results, and other clinical data. Due to privacy protections, counts fewer than 10 are suppressed and imputed. Coverage extends across all U.S. states and territories. Note that county-level and city-level stratifications could differ markedly in total sample size due to high levels of missingness of county data in some states.
epic_cosmos.restrictions: The data can be re-used with appropriate attribution. A suggested citation relating to this data is 'Results of research performed with Epic Cosmos were obtained from the PopHIVE platform (https://github.com/PopHIVE/Ingest).'
